browser_environment: System Chromium; responsive and touch emulation, including 320x568, 360x740, 390x844, 430x932, 768x900 and 844x390. External resources blocked except the existing Spotify API mock.
limitations: Not tested on a physical iPhone or Safari/WebKit. WebKit installation was unavailable in this environment.
Spotify integration was checked against the project mock; no live authenticated Spotify playback was tested.
The provided legacy browser suite references removed ClubDiagnostics and an inactive pre-existing Haruko garden. These baseline expectations were not repaired; the focused 70-check suite is separate.
asset_note: The uploaded open-view Driver photo is segmented into 13 layers. Hidden mechanical surfaces are an original vector approximation. This is not a full 3D reconstruction.
